text:
maya (PM): quick standup on private deploy roadmap: customers ask for stable egress IPs, an offline/slim installer, and KMS attestation. need a crisp MVP and owner list.

raj (Eng): egress pinning is doable for minor upgrades with a controller. major operator rewrites break guarantees unless we ship an operator-shim.

owen (Infra): shim idea: separate IP handle manager that rebinds on pod recreate. prototypeable but adds control-plane work.

noah (Security): offline bundles must be signed + pinned pubkey. KMS/HSM contract needs explicit residency language. legal in loop early.

lina (Solutions): field asks: allowlist CIDRs UI, install-only mode (no outbound), and packaged signed bundles.

tess (Eng-Ops): prototype plan: shim POC + minor-upgrade e2e tests in Q2.

maya (PM): agree. action items: 1) shim design PR (raj/tess) by 2025-04-18 2) offline-installer flags + signing (raj/owen) by 2025-04-25 3) KMS draft (noah/lina) by 2025-05-02 4) SLA/runbook (maya+sophia) by 2025-05-09.

deploy-bot: jira RED-3456 created: operator-shim prototype assigned to raj.

raj (Eng): will post a short RFC link for review.

maya (PM): thanks all, will update roadmap and ping legal if needed.
